overview: White plays 1.Nc3 d5 2.e4 dxe4 3.Bc4, attacking f7 and offering the e4 pawn Scandinavian-style. Black can keep the pawn if careful, but must watch Bxf7+ and Qh5 tricks. It is a rare gambit based on quick development.

white_ideas.idea: Play Qh5, Nxe4 and Nf3 against f7

black_ideas.idea: Defend f7 with ...Nf6 or ...e6 and keep the pawn

character.notes: Quick tactics around f7 with White a pawn down.

gambit.notes: White gives the e4 pawn and Black can hold it.

soundness.notes: Black has safe ways to defend.

character.reason: Pawn down with threats against f7, which asks for precise defence.

gambit.reason: White gives the e4 pawn and Black can keep it.

soundness.reason: Black can defend accurately and keep the pawn.

structure.reason: The e-pawn trades and bishops aim at f7.

plans.reason: White offers a pawn for time and attack on f7.
